observations: White manual sewing machine with a foot pedal and power cord.
Brand 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' and 'Super Mechanical' are printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine shows significant surface dirt and grime on the head and base.
The foot pedal is black and appears to be in good condition.
The power cord is coiled and shows some wear.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have a seized mechanism.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or the power cord may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and running.

risks.risk: The machine may have a broken presser foot or a damaged needle bar.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area and the underside of the machine.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing through fabric.
Close-up photos of the needle and presser foot area.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the machine to confirm the model and year.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
